name: VANDIRA Consultant Intent + Research Planning Engine
purpose: Convert a user question into a deterministic, auditable research plan before evidence retrieval or AI synthesis.
principles: 2024 Lok Sabha context remains separate from 2022 Assembly results
recommendations require evidence and uncertainty labels

freshness_policy.historical: fresh retrieval optional unless user asks latest/current
freshness_policy.forecast: fresh retrieval required for current context plus historical baseline
freshness_policy.canonical_2022: stable local verified dataset may be used with provenance

confidence_policy.high: multiple aligned primary/structured sources or authoritative canonical data
confidence_policy.medium: one strong source or mixed but non-conflicting evidence
confidence_policy.low: discovery-only, stale, incomplete, or unresolved evidence

unsupported_behaviors: treating reported allegations as established facts
using sensitive personal attributes for political targeting
calling 2024 Lok Sabha assembly-segment data a 2024 Assembly election result
